reasoning.step1:
1) Determine if document is an invoice:
- Contains clear invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Nummer", "Datum", line items, "Gesamtbetrag", "Zahlbetrag", VAT lines. No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" prominent. => Classify as invoice.

2) Locate Invoice.Date:
- Header shows "Datum 19.01.2024". => Invoice.Date = "19.01.2024".

3) Identify Sender.VatId:
- Two USt-Id-Nr. present: "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" (recipient) and footer "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" associated with CREATON GmbH (sender). => Sender.VatId = "ATU69710958".

4) Determine GrandTotal.Amount:
- "Zahlbetrag 24,65 EUR" is the payable total after discounts. => GrandTotal.Amount = 24.65 (converted to numeric, preserving two decimals).

5) Extract Net.Amount and Vat.Amount and Vat.Rate:
- Shows "Gesamtbetrag Netto 20,90 EUR" and "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 20,90 ... 4,18 EUR" and "Gesamtbetrag Brutto 25,08 EUR".
- VAT rate given as "20,00%". Per rules, return rate without percent => Vat.Rate = 20.00.
- Net.Amount = 20.90.
- Vat.Amount = 4.18.

6) Verify consistency and no inference:
- All extracted values explicitly present in text; no guessing. Use numeric formats with decimal point.
